text:
maya: Heads-up: propose we standardize our internal routing header to `X-RW-Route` and deprecate `X-Client-Route` to avoid collisions with downstream proxies. quick take?
aj: Fine with renaming but we need a migration plan so console metrics/dashboards don't split.
sarah: Yes — dashboards currently group by header literal. Renaming will create new buckets and be very confusing for product owners.
kai: Suggestion: accept both headers at the edge, emit a migration metric, and apply an ingestion mapping that rewrites old header key -> new key for a configurable window.
tom: SDK implications: Py/TS can do a non-breaking shim that prefers new header and logs a deprecation warn when old header is used. Go will require a minor semver bump but same behavior.
maya: Draft rollout idea: feature-flag the ingestion mapping, run for 48h in staging, then a canary 5% in prod. During that window, SDKs keep both headers for 3 releases. After telemetry shows legacy usage ~0, we remove the shim.
deploy-bot: featureflag created: rw-route-header-migration (staging)
aj: Telemetry plan: increment counters `route.header.legacy` and `route.header.renamed`. Also emit an event `route.header.mapped` when ingestion rewrites. We can use those to show migration progress on console.
sarah: Console request: surface a migration badge on route buckets and show a timeline chart with legacy vs renamed traffic. Also add an opt-out toggle so Console/SRE can disable mapping during incidents.
kai: Implementation notes: ingestion mapping should be idempotent and low-latency. Add a sampling check to avoid inflating metrics. Also ensure mapping is visible in raw logs for audits.
tom: SDK code snippet for Py I'll push:

```python
# prefer new header, fallback to old for now
route = headers.get('X-RW-Route') or headers.get('X-Client-Route')
if 'X-Client-Route' in headers:
    logger.warning('X-Client-Route is deprecated; switch to X-RW-Route')
````

maya: I'll write the RFC and include upgrade doc for customers who parse headers themselves. Also include changelog language and recommended end-of-support date.
aj: Add a dashboard alert if `route.header.legacy` drops < 50% in any critical route within 24h after mapping flip — could indicate accidental rewrites.
sarah: Coordination checklist for RFC: 1) ingestion mapping implementation owner, 2) Console UI badge + toggle owner, 3) SDK owners list (py/ts/go), 4) rollout flags and canary plan, 5) deprecation timeline.
kai: One more ask: ensure logs record which header was used (legacy vs new) so customers can correlate.
maya: OK will assign owners in RFC and propose dates: stage flag in 72h, prod canary 7d after, full mapping live 14d after. SDK deprecation 3 releases after full mapping.
tom: +1. I'll estimate the Go change and post effort by EOD.
maya: thanks everyone — I'll post RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
